name: Illustration
purpose: An animated illustration beside a headline: a bulb lighting up, a chart growing, a shield locking, people meeting. Or the caller's own Lottie animation.
use_when: an idea, a goal, a change or a feeling that's better shown than listed
avoid_when: the point is a list, steps or numbers (use their scene types)
more than one illustration scene in a row

art.desc: idea: a bulb lighting up; team: people at a table; growth: bars and a rising line; security: a shield with a lock; checklist: items ticked off; conversation: speech bubbles; time: a clock and calendar; goal: an arrow in a target

animation.desc: A Lottie ref from context.animations; shown instead of the art

hero.desc: A large illustration above the headline

example.headline: Small changes add up
example.body: One better habit a week is fifty a year.

example_beats.say: Small changes add up: one better habit a week is fifty a year.
